questions.stem: A triangular prism has a cross-section that is a right triangle with legs $3\text{ cm}$ and $4\text{ cm}$ (hypotenuse $5\text{ cm}$), and a length of $10\text{ cm}$. What is its surface area?
questions.explanation: Two triangular faces: $2 \times \frac{1}{2} \times 3 \times 4 = 12\text{ cm}^2$. Three rectangular faces: $(3 \times 10) + (4 \times 10) + (5 \times 10) = 30 + 40 + 50 = 120\text{ cm}^2$. Total $= 12 + 120 = 132\text{ cm}^2$.
